title: The AI Voice Scam Targeting Families
text:
The FTC has warned that scammers use AI voice cloning in family emergency schemes: an urgent call, a request for secrecy, then money that is hard to reverse, like wire transfers, gift cards or crypto. Agree on a family safe word, and if the caller can't give it, hang up and call back on a number you know.

Send this to your parents and grandparents tonight.

Source: https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/03/scammers-use-ai-enhance-their-family-emergency-schemes

Visuals and narration made with AI tools.
